backfillRows.why: feat-7596 prints "These domains must be chosen from among your deity's domains, your deity's alternate domains, and up to one domain that isn't on either list and isn't anathematic to your deity. Any domain spell you cast from a domain that isn't on either of your deity's lists is always heightened to 1 rank lower than usual for a focus spell." The shipped domainPool 'deity+alternate' offered only the two lists, so the outside domain was unreachable and a cleric of Alocer (deity-732: three domains, no alternates) could not answer four picks at all; the note also told the player the outside pick needs the GM's agreement, which feat-7596 does not say. New pool 'deity+alternate+one-any' offers it and enforces "up to one"; the note now prints the clause instead of a GM gate.

value.note: One of the four may come from outside both lists, as long as it isn't anathematic to your deity; a domain spell from a domain on neither list is always heightened to 1 rank lower than usual for a focus spell.
